definitions.def: (physical) Matter, material.
A large quantity; a sum.
The Eucharist, now especially in Roman Catholicism.
Fate; destiny; luck.
A prediction.
To destine; doom; change by witchcraft or sorcery.

example: There are lots of weird people in this place.

definitions.def: The act of greeting someone’s arrival, especially by saying "Welcome!"; reception.
The utterance of such a greeting.
To affirm or greet the arrival of someone, especially by saying "Welcome!".

example: We welcome suggestions for improvement.

definitions.def: Health, safety, happiness and prosperity; well-being in any respect.
Various forms of financial aid provided by the government to those who are in need of it (abbreviated form of welfare assistance).
To provide with welfare or aid.

example: welfaring the poor

definitions.def: In good health.
Good, content.
(manner) Accurately, competently, satisfactorily.

example: I had been sick, but now I'm well.

definitions.def: One of the four principal compass points, specifically 270°, conventionally directed to the left on maps; the direction of the setting sun at an equinox, abbreviated as W.
To move to the west; (of the sun) to set.
Situated or lying in or toward the west; westward.

A film, or some other dramatic work, set in, the historic (c. 1850-1910) American West (west of the Mississippi river) focusing on conflict between whites and Indians, lawmen and outlaws, ranchers and farmers, or industry (railroads, mining) and agriculture.
Of, facing, situated in, or related to the west.
(of a wind) Blowing from the west; westerly.

example: the western approaches

definitions.def: Liquid or moisture.
Rainy weather.
To cover or impregnate with liquid.

example: Don't go out in the wet.

definitions.def: (Singlish) Used to contradict an underlying assumption held by the interlocutor.
Something; thing; stuff.
The identity of a thing, as an answer to a question of what.

example: The market will calculate these higher risks in their funding costs what might result in higher lending rates.

definitions.def: Unexceptional or unimportant; blah.
At all, absolutely, whatsoever.
No matter what; for any

example: There is no point whatever in going on with this discussion.

definitions.def: A circular device capable of rotating on its axis, facilitating movement or transportation or performing labour in machines.
The breaking wheel, an old instrument of torture.
To roll along on wheels.

example: Wheel that trolley over here, would you?

definitions.def: The time at which something happens.
(interrogative) At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.
At an earlier time and under different, usually less favorable, circumstances.

example: A good article will cover the who, the what, the when, the where, the why and the how.

definitions.def: (interrogative) When ever: emphatic form of when.
At any time.
At any time that.

example: Whenever will I find time to finish that jigsaw?

definitions.def: The place in which something happens.
Interrogative adverb, used in either a direct or indirect question: at what place; to what place; what place.
In what situation.

example: A good article will cover the who, the what, the when, the where, the why and the how.

definitions.def: A clause, as in legal documents, stating whereas.
Where (that).
In contrast; whilst on the contrary; although.

example: He came first in the race, whereas his brother came last.

definitions.def: An emphatic form of where.
In or to whatever place; anywhere.
In all places; everywhere.

example: Wherever have you been all my life?

definitions.def: Which of two.
Introducing a direct interrogative question (often with correlative or) which indicates doubt between alternatives.
Used to introduce an indirect interrogative question that consists of multiple alternative possibilities (usually with correlative or).

example: He chose the correct answer, but I don't know whether it was by luck or (whether it was) by skill.

definitions.def: (interrogative) What one or ones (of those mentioned or implied).
The/Any ones that; whichever.

example: By now, you must surely know which is which.

definitions.def: An uncertain duration of time, a period of time.
To pass (time) idly.
To occupy or entertain (someone) in order to let time pass.

example: He lectured for quite a long while.

definitions.def: (rare or literary in North America) While, at the same time.

example: Drivers must switch off engines whilst on stand.

definitions.def: The act of speaking in a quiet voice, especially, without vibration of the vocal cords.
(usually in the plural) A rumor.

To speak softly, or under the breath, so as to be heard only by one near at hand; to utter words without sonant breath; to talk without that vibration in the larynx which gives sonorous, or vocal, sound.

example: There are whispers of rebellion all around.

definitions.def: The color/colour of snow or milk; the colour of light containing equal amounts of all visible wavelengths.
A person of European descent with light-coloured skin.
To make white; to whiten; to bleach.

example: Write in black ink on white paper.

definitions.def: A person under discussion; a question of which person.
(interrogative) What person or people; which person or people; asks for the identity of someone. (used in a direct or indirect question)
(interrogative) What is one's position; asks whether someone deserves to say or do something.

example: I don't know who it is. (indirect question)

definitions.def: Something complete, without any parts missing.
An entirety.
Entire, undivided.

example: This variety of fascinating details didn't fall together into an enjoyable, coherent whole.

definitions.def: Reason
For what cause, reason, or purpose (interrogative adverb).
For which cause, reason, or purpose (relative adverb).

example: A good article will cover the who, the what, the when, the where, the why and the how.

definitions.def: A ball that passes so far from the batsman that the umpire deems it unplayable; the arm signal used by an umpire to signal a wide; the extra run added to the batting side's score
Having a large physical extent from side to side.
Large in scope.

example: We walked down a wide corridor.

definitions.def: In a wide manner; across a wide area.
Commonly; generally; to a great degree.
A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.
The female of a pair of mated animals.
(said of men) to marry

example: A new wife for the gander is introduced into the pen.

definitions.def: The undomesticated state of a wild animal
(chiefly in the plural) a wilderness
To commit random acts of assault, robbery, and rape in an urban setting, especially as a gang.

example: After mending the lion's leg, we returned him to the wild.

definitions.def: (now uncommon or literary) To wish, desire (something).
(nowadays rare) To wish or desire (that something happen); to intend (that).

example: Do what you will.

definitions.def: To conquer, defeat.
To reach some destination or object, despite difficulty or toil (now usually intransitive, with preposition or locative adverb).
Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.
Air artificially put in motion by any force or action.
To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.

example: As they accelerated onto the motorway, the wind tore the plywood off the car's roof-rack.

definitions.def: The inedible parts of a grain-producing plant.
Straw or hay cut up fine for the food of cattle.
An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

example: To separate out the chaff, early cultures tossed baskets of grain into the air and let the wind blow away the lighter chaff.

definitions.def: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting the juice of grapes.
An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting the juice of fruits or vegetables other than grapes, usually preceded by the type of the fruit or vegetable; for example, "dandelion wine".
To entertain with wine.

example: She ordered some wine for the meal.

definitions.def: An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly; a similar fin at the side of a ray or similar fish
Human arm.
To injure slightly (as with a gunshot), especially in the wing or arm.
One who has won or often wins.
definitions.trans: 曾经获胜或经常获胜的人。

definitions.def: A point or goal that wins a competition.
definitions.trans: 赢得比赛的分数或目标。

definitions.def: Traditionally the fourth of the four seasons, typically regarded as being from December 23 to March 20 in continental regions of the Northern Hemisphere or the months of June, July and August in the Southern Hemisphere. It is the time when the sun is lowest in the sky, resulting in short days, and the time of year with the lowest atmospheric temperatures for the region.
The period of decay, old age, death, or the like.
To spend the winter (in a particular place).

example: When they retired, they hoped to winter in Florida.

definitions.def: The act of wiping something.
A soft piece of cloth or cloth-like material used for wiping.
To move an object over, maintaining contact, with the intention of removing some substance from the surface. (Compare rub.)

example: multiple wipes of a computer's hard disk

definitions.def: Metal formed into a thin, even thread, now usually by being drawn through a hole in a steel die.
A piece of such material; a thread or slender rod of metal, a cable.
To fasten with wire, especially with reference to wine bottles, corks, or fencing.

example: We need to wire that hole in the fence.

definitions.def: To become wise.
Usually with "up", to inform or learn.
Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

example: After Mo had a word with him, he wised up.

definitions.def: A desire, hope, or longing for something or for something to happen.
An expression of such a desire, often connected with ideas of magic and supernatural power.
To desire; to want.

example: I'll come tomorrow, if you wish it.

definitions.def: Along, together with others, in a group, etc.
Against.
In the company of; alongside, close to; near to.

example: Do you want to come with?

definitions.def: To pull (something) back, aside, or away.
To stop talking to, or interacting with, other people and start thinking thoughts that are not related to what is happening around.
In the context of which the present document or ruling is made.
In or into the interior; inside.
In the inner part, spatially; physically inside.

example: the within appeal

definitions.def: Outside, externally. This is still used in the names of some civil parishes in England, e.g. St Cuthbert Without.
Lacking something.
Outside of, beyond.

example: Being from a large, poor family, he learned to live without.

definitions.def: Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.
One who sees or has personal knowledge of something.
To furnish proof of, to show.

example: She can bear witness, since she was there at the time.

definitions.def: An adult female human.
(collective) All females collectively; womankind.
To staff with female labor.
Something that causes amazement or awe; a marvel.
Something astonishing and seemingly inexplicable.
To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

example: Wonders of the World seem to come in sevens.

definitions.def: Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary.
Surprisingly excellent; very good or admirable, extremely impressive.
Exceedingly, to a great extent.

example: They served a wonderful six-course meal.

definitions.def: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.
The wood of a particular species of tree.
To cover or plant with trees.

example: There was lots of wood on the beach.

definitions.def: Made of wood.
As if made of wood; moving awkwardly, or speaking with dull lack of emotion.

example: On a recent windy day, hundreds of visitors climbed wooden stairs to take pictures in front of the glacier.

definitions.def: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)
Something like such a unit of language:
To say or write (something) using particular words; to phrase (something).

example: I’m not sure how to word this letter to the council.

definitions.def: (heading) Employment.
(heading) Effort.
A person who performs labor for a living, especially manual labor.
A nonreproductive social insect, such as ant, bee, termite, or wasp.
(with "the") Human collective existence; existence in general.
The Universe.
To consider or cause to be considered from a global perspective; to consider as a global whole, rather than making or focussing on national or other distinctions; compare globalise.

example: There will always be lovers, till the world’s end.

definitions.def: A strong feeling of anxiety.
An instance or cause of such a feeling.
To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

example: I'm afflicted by worry throughout the night.

definitions.def: Value.
Merit, excellence.
Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.
definitions.trans: 具有以下价值；适合兑换。

definitions.def: Deserving of.

example: I’ll have a dollar's worth of candy, please.

definitions.def: Something that would happen, or would be the case, under different circumstances; a potentiality.
An injury, such as a cut, stab, or tear, to a (usually external) part of the body.
A hurt to a person's feelings, reputation, prospects, etc.
To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

example: It took a long time to get over the wound of that insult.

definitions.def: To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.
To enclose or coil around an object or organism, as a form of grasping.

example: A snake wraps itself around its prey.

definitions.def: The act or style of writing.
The operation of storing data, as in memory or onto disk.
To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

example: How many writes per second can this hard disk handle?

definitions.def: A person who writes, or produces literary work.
Anything that writes or produces output.

example: Has your girlfriend written you another letter already? She’s quite a writer!

definitions.def: Something that is immoral or not good.
An instance of wronging someone (sometimes with possessive to indicate the wrongdoer).
To treat unjustly; to injure or harm.

example: Injustice is a heinous wrong.

definitions.def: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.
The property surrounding one's house, typically dominated by one's lawn.
To confine to a yard.
Expressing joy, celebration, glee, etc.

example: Yeah! We did it!

definitions.def: A solar year, the time it takes the Earth to complete one revolution of the Sun (between 365.24 and 365.26 days depending on the point of reference).

(by extension) The time it takes for any astronomical object (such as a planet, dwarf planet, small Solar System body, or comet) in direct orbit around a star (such as the Sun) to make one revolution around the star.

example: we moved to this town a year ago;  I quit smoking exactly one year ago

definitions.def: The colour of gold, butter, or a lemon; the colour obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light.
The intermediate light in a set of three traffic lights, the illumination of which indicates that drivers should stop short of the intersection if it is safe to do so.
To become yellow or more yellow.
An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.
A vote of support or in favor/favour of something.
To agree with, affirm, approve.

example: Was that a yes?

definitions.def: The day immediately before today; one day ago.
The recent past, often disparaging.
On the day before today.
As soon as possible.

example: Today is the child of yesterday and the parent of tomorrow.

definitions.def: (usually with negative) Thus far; up to the present; up to some specified time; still
Continuously up to the current time; still.
Nevertheless; however; but; despite that.

example: He has never yet been late for an appointment;   I’m not yet wise enough to answer that;   Have you finished yet?

definitions.def: To pay, give in payment; repay, recompense; reward; requite.
To furnish; to afford; to render; to give forth.
To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).
(object pronoun) The people spoken, or written to, as an object.
(reflexive pronoun) (To) yourselves, (to) yourself.

example: Both of you should get ready now.

definitions.def: People who are young; young people, collectively; youth.
Young or immature offspring (especially of an animal).
To become or seem to become younger.

example: The young of today are well-educated.

definitions.def: (reflexive pronoun) Your own self (singular).
You (singular); used emphatically, especially to indicate exclusiveness of the referent's participation in the predicate, i.e., that no one else is involved.

example: Be careful with that fire or you'll burn yourself.

definitions.def: The quality or state of being young.
The part of life following childhood; the period of existence preceding maturity or age; the whole early part of life, from childhood, or, sometimes, from infancy, to adulthood.

example: Her youth and beauty attracted him to her.

definitions.def: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).
Any given region or area of the world.
To divide into or assign sections or areas.

example: Please zone off our staging area, a section for each group.
